# Prince Juguilon Portfolio API

Use this scoped index when calling the versioned REST resources.

- API guide: https://prince.juguilon.com/api.md
- OpenAPI: https://prince.juguilon.com/openapi.json
- Index: https://prince.juguilon.com/api/v1
- Profile: https://prince.juguilon.com/api/v1/profile
- Resume: https://prince.juguilon.com/api/v1/resume
- Projects: https://prince.juguilon.com/api/v1/projects
- Blogs: https://prince.juguilon.com/api/v1/blogs

No credentials are required. Errors are JSON objects with code, message, and resolution fields.
